active_work_package.title: next_action.requires, per fixture, no inherited default, nothing sealed moved - issue #52 item 3 (NS-033, DEC-033 form iii)
active_work_package.objective: Add computed.next_action.requires to the resume schema (3.0.0) naming the observed.* and asserted.* keys the action consumes; assign it in each fixture function with no default in base(); have build.py read the shape rules from the schema and refuse an edge that names no existing key; hold resume_decision, computed.freshness, stop_conditions and every oracle byte-identical to the 2.0.0 set by test.

stop_reason: WP-036 is built, reviewed and fixed on this branch, and its merge waits on one recorded human line on issue #52: may next_action.requires name asserted.* keys, given DEC-026 disposition 5 says 'an existing observation'? The first draft of this package read a session instruction as that answer; the fresh-context review held, under DEC-002 and AGENTS.md section 2, that chat is not recorded authority, and the package was returned to WAIT_FOR_AUTHORITY (DEC-038 as rewritten). If the answer is yes, this head merges as reviewed. If no, the edge drops asserted.* and becomes ['observed.main_sha'] on eight fixtures, or item 3 is deferred to the independent oracle author. Content work (issue #73, NS-037) proceeds in its own package meanwhile.
